# Upgrade Requirements Quality Checklist: Upgrade Spring Boot Version

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of requirements for the Spring Boot framework upgrade across the platform
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness & Framework Scope

- [x] CHK001 Are all 8 microservices, gateway, and shared contracts explicitly included in the framework upgrade scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are companion ecosystem BOM coordinates (Spring Cloud, Springdoc OpenAPI, Testcontainers, Flyway) explicitly identified for coordinated alignment? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 Are baseline runtime properties (Java 26 / Virtual Threads) specified as mandatory preserved configurations? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [x] CHK004 Is the modern test mocking pattern explicitly specified with the target annotation type (`@MockitoBean`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK005 Are deprecated configuration property replacements documented without ambiguous terminology? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Is the expected status format and response timing for Actuator health probes quantified? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage & Business Invariance

- [x] CHK007 Are end-to-end regression scenarios defined covering asynchronous Kafka event outbox and listener choreography? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK008 Are Redis cache invalidation and CQRS availability search behaviors required to remain functional post-upgrade? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK009 Are interactive Swagger UI accessibility and OpenAPI specification endpoints verified per service? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]

## Edge Cases & Quality Gates

- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for handling third-party starter incompatibilities during compilation? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Can the requirement for zero compiler or runtime deprecation warnings be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK012 Is the Definition of Done verified by a 100% clean Maven reactor build pass rate? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
